description: Used only by the messaging integration tests. No service publishes or consumes it.

eventId.description: Unique id of this event; the consumer inbox key.

occurredOn.description: Business date on which the event happened.

performedBy.description: Actor id that caused the event, 'system' by default.

key.description: Message key; events with the same key must be handled in order.

sequence.description: Position of the event within its key.

amount.description: Money; amount is a decimal string so no consumer loses precision.
